other_material_facts.value: OUR MANUFACTURING FACILITIES We operate three manufacturing units at E-411, E-412, and E-413, GIDC, Sanand Ahmedabad, along with our corporate headquarters in Ahmedabad.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: OUR CUSTOMERS We supply IML packaging to a wide range of industries, including sweets, dairy products, ice cream, ready-to-eat foods, bakery, confectionery, pharmaceuticals, agro food products and frozen foods.

other_material_facts.label: technology_ip
other_material_facts.value: We position ourselves as a solutions partner that aligns design, materials, labelling, and tooling with production realities so that packaging enhances shelf presence, protects product integrity, and supports reliable throughput on customer lines.

other_material_facts.label: certifications
other_material_facts.value: The Company is certified for key international management standards, reflecting its focus on quality, environmental responsibility, workplace safety, and process reliability.

other_material_facts.label: certifications
other_material_facts.value: In addition, the Company is certified under ISO/IEC 17025:2017 for compliance with general requirements for the competence of testing and calibration laboratories, further strengthening its commitment to maintaining testing accuracy and product quality across its manufacturing operations.

other_material_facts.label: customer_qualification
other_material_facts.value: Along the way, we have built an engagement model that starts early in product development, collaborates on artwork, mold/label harmonisation, and specification control, and then carries programs through trials, qualification, and steady-state supply so that branding choices translate cleanly into production.

other_material_facts.label: vertical_integration
other_material_facts.value: For IML, production is fully in-house and backed by backward integration through Octa Labels, our Promoter Group entity that ensures uninterrupted label supply and consistent quality.

other_material_facts.label: vertical_integration
other_material_facts.value: In parallel, our in-house mold-designing for End Caps and our ability to deliver larger-size caps quickly help us address complex industrial requirements while controlling cycle time and finish quality.

other_material_facts.label: technology_ip
other_material_facts.value: This ecosystem, including tooling, labelling, molding, and finishing, improves repeatability, reduces changeover risk, and supports consistent outcomes on customer lines.

other_material_facts.label: vertical_integration
other_material_facts.value: In End Caps, we follow a hybrid model that combines job work with in-house production, enabling flexibility for diverse pipe sizes and custom features.

other_material_facts.label: customer_qualification
other_material_facts.value: We remain focused on packaging that delivers both improved product appearance and line performance, grounded in early collaboration, strict qualification, and operations engineered for repeatable speed and quality.

other_material_facts.label: technology_ip
other_material_facts.value: By keeping tooling, label integration, and molding under one roof, we eliminate handoffs that typically introduce variability, so artwork approvals translate cleanly into production without rework or delays.

other_material_facts.label: customer_qualification
other_material_facts.value: Managing both inside a single governance and QA framework lets us share tooling know-how, CTQ controls, and automation practices, so development gates (design approval, trials, qualification, run-at-rate) remain consistent even when the end use differs.
